thread_text:
olivia: Quick heads-up: prepping an engine swap with kernel+quant changes during tonight's 22:00 UTC window. I pushed a prebake to staging and want a short bakeout + thermal/latency sanity check. What gating metrics should we use?

raj: Which kernel/quant tags are we testing? Any red flags from prebake so far?

olivia: Kernel tag: engine-kernel@v8.4.0, quant build: quantizer@q3-2026. Prebake running on staging-a. Perf looks mostly OK but one node shows a ~3% P99 bump on seq_len=2048. Not sure if it's noise.

simon: Can we run a focused workload: batch sizes 1..8, seq 256/1024/2048, and KV-heavy paths? I'll spin up targeted jobs.

mai: @deploy-bot scheduling prebake tasks. Command: `deploy-bot run prebake --tag engine-kernel@v8.4.0 --quant quantizer@q3-2026 --nodes staging-a --tests perf,smoke,thermal`

deploy-bot: Prebake started (id pb-2940001112). Expected duration ~12m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/pb/pb-2940001112

raj: If that P99 persists on more nodes (>1 node), we should pin back to engine-kernel@v8.3.9 and investigate KV eviction heuristics. Also add a telemetry counter for eviction_count per request.

olivia: Proposed rollforward criteria: median latency change <1.5%, P99 delta <2%, eviction_rate increase <10% cluster-wide. If any condition fails, we pin to engine-kernel@v8.3.9 and abort the rollout.

simon: Prebake logs: looks like staging-a-3 had GPU memory scheduling spikes during long sequences. Might be driver-related. I'll reproduce with an isolated run.

deploy-bot: Prebake pb-2940001112 finished. Summary: median tokens/s +0.4%, P99 latency +3.1% on staging-a-3 for seq_len=2048. Eviction_rate +4% cluster-wide. Summary artifact: https://ci.redwood/pb/pb-2940001112/artifacts/summary.json

mai: P99 +3.1% is above the rollforward threshold. Next steps?

olivia: Options: (1) Block rollforward & pin, (2) Investigate and patch (longer), (3) Re-run prebake with an older/newer driver pinned to see if it's scheduling. I prefer (3) to quickly isolate.

simon: Agree. I'll run prebake with driver@dp-510 pinned. @deploy-bot run prebake --driver dp-510 --tag engine-kernel@v8.4.0 --quant quantizer@q3-2026 --nodes staging-a --tests perf,smoke

deploy-bot: Prebake pb-2940001135 started with driver dp-510. ETA ~10m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/pb/pb-2940001135

raj: If dp-510 fixes the tail, treat as driver interaction. We can still rollforward kernel but document driver requirement in release notes and advise Dedicated customers.

olivia: Drafting release note blurb: "Engine kernel v8.4.0 — improved matmul and quant paths; observed P99 sensitivity on older drivers. Recommended driver: dp-510 for optimal tail latency. Known issue: transient P99 increase on older drivers; fallback: pin driver or use legacy quant profile." Will paste link once ready.

simon: Prebake pb-2940001135 finished: P99 +0.6% across nodes, median +0.3%, eviction_rate +2%. Looks acceptable with dp-510.

deploy-bot: Noted. Scheduling production rollout: 22:00 UTC window. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback if P99 > baseline +2% for a sustained 10m.

olivia: Proceed with that plan. I'll post release notes, tag product & CS, and update the rollout config. If first 25% fails, abort and pin to engine-kernel@v8.3.9.

raj: I'll own telemetry during rollout. Setting dashboard alert: P99 delta >1.8% and eviction_rate delta >7%. Will page on trigger.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. On-call: raj, simon. Escalation order: olivia -> eng-sre -> eng-runtime leads.

mai: Added release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/engine-v8.4.0-draft. Also updated Console rollout config. :thumbsup:

olivia: Thanks all. If anything flaps during the 25% step, call abort. Otherwise we'll continue the staged rollout and follow the post-deploy checklist.
